sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 19 Qualification To Hold Public Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

QUALIFICATION TO HOLD PUBLIC ORDER, 2002
QUALIFICATION TO HOLD PUBLIC ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER NO.19 OF 2002
An Order to
provide for limitations to hold highest public offices.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 6th July, 2002]
F.No.2(4)l2002-Pub., dated
6-7-2002.--The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Qualification to Hold
Public Offices Order, 2002.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 19 Qualification To Hold Public Order 2002
sections.description:
Qualification to hold certain public offices

QUALIFICATION TO HOLD PUBLIC ORDER, 2002
QUALIFICATION TO HOLD PUBLIC ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER NO.19 OF 2002
An Order to
provide for limitations to hold highest public offices.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 6th July, 2002]
F.No.2(4)l2002-Pub., dated
6-7-2002.--The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Qualification to hold
certain public offices.--Notwithstanding anything contained in the
Constitution or any other law for the time being in force, a person who has, at
any time, held the office of the Prime Minister, or that of a Chief Minister of
a Province or a combination of such offices for two terms, irrespective of
whether any one of the two or both the terms of office were completed or not,
shall not be qualified to hold the office of the Prime Minister or that of a
Chief Minister.
